sections.section_title: HDP general purpose output clear register (HDP_GPOCLR)
sections.text_helper: Section 77.4.5 "HDP general purpose output clear register (HDP_GPOCLR)" in chapter 77 (Hardware debug port (HDP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4371.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x018
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 HDPGPOCLR[7:0]: When a bit is written to 1, the corresponding HDP GPO is cleared.
Writing a bit to 0 has no effect.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: HDPGPOCLR[7:0]
fields.description: When a bit is written to 1, the corresponding HDP GPO is cleared. Writing a bit to 0 has no effect.
